messages:
anya_cs: async: VelocitiHealth reported 503s from our webhook endpoint after renewal notification went out. Seeing ~30% delivery failures since 03:20 UTC. Opening thread to track triage + customer comms. TL;DR: webhook errors -> retries exhausted -> items stuck in retry queue. Need Eng to confirm root cause and advise workaround.

devon_eng: on it, pinging oncall.

sam_oncall: saw alerts, investigating. can you paste a sample payload/id?

anya_cs: here's one id 0f9c7a. Payload (redacted): ```{ "event": "renewal.sent", "customer": "VelocitiHealth", "attempt": 3 }``` Happened at 03:21:12 UTC. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5432

lee_platform: quick note — we rolled a routing tweak to the webhook proxy at 03:00 UTC to prefer egress-eu for EU customers. Might correlate.

devon_eng: confirming proxy logs show 502/504 responses from upstream to the customer's endpoint. Replaying one locally: ```curl -v -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://webhook-proxy.redwood/push -d @payload.json``` upstream returns timeout 504. likely upstream endpoint rejecting or timing out.

anya_cs: customer says they did a firewall rule rotation during their maintenance window. asked them to confirm whether our IP ranges were blocked.

sam_oncall: temp mitigation: enable automatic retries with exponential backoff + jitter. that helps future requests but won't unstick items already marked failed. devon can we requeue exhausted items for CS-5432?

devon_eng: I can requeue. running dry-run first: `./tools/requeue_webhooks --ticket 5432 --dry-run` then actual if looks right. also opened PR to add clearer failure reasons in console (https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/987).

anya_cs: customer has renewal call at 16:00 PT. if we can requeue + apply short-term egress fallback to us-west by 15:30 PT, should keep renewal on track.

lee_platform: I can add a fallback route policy for VelocitiHealth to use the us-west pool for the next 2 hours. applying ACL and route now.

devon_eng: requeued ~120 messages for the ticket and started monitor. posting quick logs in 10m. PR ready for review — @lee_platform can you eyeball the routing flag change? small delta.

lee_platform: reviewing now, left one nit about comment. will approve after CI passes.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy of routing-change to us-west finished at 2469123600.

devon_eng: monitoring shows errors dropping to <1% after requeue + fallback. will watch for 30m. next actions: postmortem note, add runbook step to check firewall blocks during renewal flows, add alert for retry-queue growth.

anya_cs: thanks team. i'll update VelocitiHealth: requeued items and temporary route applied; monitoring in progress. renewal call still on. will post a status update in ~45m.

sam_oncall: :thumbsup:
